text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh. Excellent...! The heat is washing 
over my body in waves...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Upon my soul, I swear it here and now! I 
shall bring forth an even greater fervor 
than today—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet is the real deal after all! 
He's gotta be the top contender for this 
year's Derby...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
That late-race burst was seriously insane! 
So totally cool...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oooohhh...! Everyone's talking about 
Gimlet-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So this is what it means to 'captivate 
with your running'... I want to run like 
that someday, too—

"Tanino Gimlet returns after putting on a 
display of powerful running in the Satsuki 
Sho—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—The prelude is over. It's finally time to 
begin.
choice_data_list: Ah, next up is the NHK Mile Cup...!
Yeah, next up is the NHK Mile Cup...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"Tanino Gimlet-saaan! Do you have a moment 
to spare!?"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: An interview, huh? —Hmph. Perfect timing.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
You don't mind, right, Trainer? I'm going 
to show them.

I knew what that meant without having to 
ask. So, I gave a firm, reassuring nod—

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
That was another fantastic run at the 
Satsuki Sho! Will your next race naturally 
be the Japan Derby?! We would love to hear 
your thoughts—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —The next race is not the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: My next race is... the NHK Mile Cup.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
W-What...! So from now on, you won't be 
aiming for the Derby, and instead focusing 
entirely on the mile division?!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
That too is incorrect. All I said was that 
"the Derby would not be the next race".

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Now is the time to loudly proclaim it! I 
am—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"The NHK Mile Cup and the Japanese Derby! 
I will run in both!!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean, no way— Wait, the "MC 
Rotation"!?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Come, spread the word far and 
wide! And prepare yourselves!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The destruction brought by Tanino 
Gimlet—in that sinister, vivid flash!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"—Regarding Tanino Gimlet's recently 
announced challenge to the Mile 
Championship rotation, fans are still 
voicing a wide variety of opinions 
today...!"

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"‘I was honestly surprised! I totally 
thought Gimlet would go straight to the 
Derby...!’"

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Still, it's a thrilling challenge, isn't 
it...! I really want to see her conquer 
the Mile Championship rotation!"

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"She's my fave, so of course I support 
her, but honestly, I'm a little worried. I 
mean, isn't that race rotation super 
packed?"

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"‘I was honestly so happy just seeing her 
run the Derby, so I couldn't help thinking 
she didn't need to push herself that 
hard—’"

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"While there are many voices of support, 
we also see concerns being raised over 
this grueling challenge."

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"Well, isn't that a natural reaction? 
Especially considering Gimlet's stellar 
runs up to this point."

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"To put it plainly, Tanino Gimlet has 
shown the kind of strength that puts her 
closest to claiming the title of Derby 
Umamusume right now."

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"That's precisely why I want her to focus 
on the Derby. As a fan, I think that's a 
completely natural wish."

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"'Even if it's her own choice, I really 
hope she doesn't push herself too hard. I 
mean, it'd be amazing if she actually 
pulled it off, but—'"

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"It's precisely because expectations are 
high! What will happen in the upcoming NHK 
Mile Cup? We'll definitely want to keep 
our eyes on it!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Just as expected.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The more harshness they perceive in my 
path, the more brilliantly and vividly the 
radiance known as "Me" will shine.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"All the more reason to embrace this 
chaos. For in the end, everything will be 
scorched by the indelible mark I leave 
behind in the annals of battle."

Just as Tanino Gimlet said, the more 
interest grows in the Mile Championship 
rotation, the greater the impact of her 
challenge and triumph will be.

At the same time, the fans' concerns were 
entirely justified. No matter how you 
looked at it, the fact that the 
Matsumoto-Clever rotation was brutally 
demanding could not be changed.
choice_data_list:
(I will definitely see this through 
safely.)

text_block_list.text:
For Tanino Gimlet's sake, and for the sake 
of everyone cheering her on, I won't let 
this challenge end in failure.

Tanino Gimlet, too, would hurt no one, 
manifesting historic fervor upon the 
world...!

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
"—Here is the latest evidence regarding 
stretching that I mentioned previously."

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, you're truly dedicated. To be 
conducting research on papers alongside 
your everyday Trainer duties."
choice_data_list: I want to do everything within my power.

text_block_list.text:
If it meant helping Tanino Gimlet make it 
through the grueling Mile Championship 
rotation safely, I reaffirmed my resolve 
to do whatever it takes――

"I'll acquire all the knowledge and skill 
necessary for it at maximum speed, without 
wasting a single split second...!"

“—As a Trainer, in order to become 
'stronger'...!”

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Just as I thought, the core of your 
being... is unreadable. How you move 
forward... I can't see it at all.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
In other words, an entity beyond all 
bounds—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh. That is precisely why――

The fateful showdown, the NHK Mile Cup, 
was steadily drawing near—
